title: Microwave Mug Cake
summary: Gather a microwave-safe mug or bowl, measuring tools and ingredients, mix flour, sugar, cocoa, leavening, milk and oil directly in the mug, microwave about 70-90 seconds, rest briefly, then top and eat.
source: open-set draft from 8 frames + the person's description 'making Mug Cake'

nodes.name: Get a microwave-safe mug or bowl
nodes.instruction_novice: Grab a clean, microwave-safe mug or small bowl that holds at least 12 ounces. Set it on your work surface.
nodes.end_state: An empty mug or bowl sits on the counter or stovetop.

checks.question: Is this step done: Get a microwave-safe mug or bowl?

nodes.name: Gather measuring spoons and utensils
nodes.instruction_novice: Pull out measuring spoons and a fork or small spoon for mixing.
nodes.end_state: Measuring spoons and a fork lie next to the mug.

checks.question: Is this step done: Gather measuring spoons and utensils?

nodes.name: Collect the ingredients
nodes.instruction_novice: Get flour, sugar, cocoa powder, baking powder, salt, milk, and oil from the pantry and fridge.
nodes.end_state: All ingredient containers are lined up beside the mug.

checks.question: Is this step done: Collect the ingredients?

nodes.name: Add dry ingredients to mug
nodes.instruction_novice: Measure about 4 tablespoons flour, 2 to 3 tablespoons sugar, 2 tablespoons cocoa, a quarter teaspoon baking powder, and a pinch of salt into the mug.
nodes.end_state: A mound of mixed dry powders sits in the bottom of the mug.

checks.question: Is this step done: Add dry ingredients to mug?

nodes.name: Whisk dry ingredients together
nodes.instruction_novice: Stir the dry ingredients with the fork so there are no cocoa clumps.
nodes.end_state: The dry mix looks uniform brown with no lumps.

checks.question: Is this step done: Whisk dry ingredients together?

nodes.name: Add milk and oil
nodes.instruction_novice: Pour in about 3 tablespoons milk and 1 to 2 tablespoons oil, plus a splash of vanilla if you have it.
nodes.end_state: Liquid sits on top of the dry mix in the mug.

checks.question: Is this step done: Add milk and oil?

nodes.name: Stir into smooth batter
nodes.instruction_novice: Mix until smooth, scraping the bottom and sides of the mug so no dry flour is left.
nodes.end_state: The mug holds a smooth, glossy batter with no dry pockets.

checks.question: Is this step done: Stir into smooth batter?

nodes.name: Add mix-ins if desired
nodes.instruction_novice: Drop in a few chocolate chips or other mix-ins and gently press them into the batter.
nodes.end_state: Chocolate chips or mix-ins are visible in the batter surface.

checks.question: Is this step done: Add mix-ins if desired?

nodes.name: Microwave the mug cake
nodes.instruction_novice: Put the mug in the center of the microwave and cook on high for about 70 to 90 seconds, until the top looks set.
nodes.end_state: The cake has risen in the mug with a set, slightly springy top.

checks.question: Is this step done: Microwave the mug cake?

nodes.name: Remove carefully and cool
nodes.instruction_novice: Use an oven mitt to take the hot mug out and let it rest for a minute or two.
nodes.end_state: The mug sits on the counter with steam rising off the cake.

checks.question: Is this step done: Remove carefully and cool?

nodes.name: Top and serve
nodes.instruction_novice: Add any topping you like, such as ice cream or whipped cream, and grab a spoon to eat.
nodes.end_state: The finished mug cake is topped and a spoon is in it.

checks.question: Is this step done: Top and serve?

nodes.name: Clean up the workspace
nodes.instruction_novice: Put the ingredients away and place the measuring spoons in the sink or dishwasher.
nodes.end_state: The counter is clear of ingredients and used tools.

checks.question: Is this step done: Clean up the workspace?
